designSystemScope: Separate physical Figma design-system board for RoamPass only, documenting light route-booking tokens, travel modules, placeholder-safe media zones, component states, and editable source hygiene.

typographyTokens.display: Inter 68/0, Extra Bold, optimistic travel hero
typographyTokens.h3: Inter 23/0, Semi Bold, ticket card title
typographyTokens.bodySmall: Inter 14/0, Regular, route metadata and support copy
typographyTokens.label: Inter 12/0, Semi Bold uppercase, badge and ticket labels
typographyTokens.button: Inter 15/0, Semi Bold, confident booking CTA

spacingTokens.sectionY: 104 airy travel rhythm with denser fare section at 80
spacingTokens.componentPadding: 16 form fields, 24 ticket cards, 32 planner boards
spacingTokens.cardGap: 20 compact route cards, 28 standard cards, 36 major proof modules

components: header navigation with saved route chip and booking button
button primary, secondary, outline, selected fare, disabled state
card route ticket, booking step, destination proof, fare comparison, support assurance, testimonial, travel package

componentAnatomy.navigation header: logo mark, route links, saved route chip, booking button, responsive spacing
componentAnatomy.button: label, optional icon zone, green action fill, outline variant, disabled contrast state
componentAnatomy.card: ticket surface, route metadata, price or support proof, placeholder/media area, CTA footer
componentAnatomy.cta: ticket-pass headline, supporting copy, primary booking action, reassurance bullet
componentAnatomy.footer: brand block, travel links, support links, legal and currency row
componentAnatomy.placeholder: visible text clue naming destination, route, map, boarding pass, support, or profile role

patternModules: route planner hero with booking-form board
FAQ checklist and final CTA closure
usageRules: Use forest green for booking confidence, selected fares, and primary conversion only.
Use sky accent as route/navigation cue, not as the main CTA color.
Keep media zones as editable text placeholders with route-specific purpose labels.
Do not reuse KineticCast's dark broadcast console rhythm or red signal CTA behavior.
Major sections, route cards, forms, pricing, testimonials, and design-system modules use real auto-layout.

surfaceEffectTokens.cardShadow: soft warm shadow under ticket and planner surfaces
surfaceEffectTokens.selectedFare: green border, pale green fill, and price emphasis
surfaceEffectTokens.routeAccent: thin sky divider or route-line cue
surfaceEffectTokens.fareBandContrast: deep green surface for dense price comparison pause

placeholderRules.media: Use `image placeholder: [purpose]` inside destination, route map, station, boarding-pass, and app-preview areas.
placeholderRules.people: Use `profile photo placeholder: [role]` for traveler testimonials.
placeholderRules.charts: Use editable comparison rows instead of bitmap charts.
placeholderRules.restriction: No final generated photos are embedded unless explicitly requested.

sourceHygiene.notes: Homepage and design-system frames use named section layers and modular auto-layout; decorative surfaces are separated from editable route content.
